notice: Unofficial fan-made roadmap. These fictional milestones and estimates are not an announced or verified trophy list.

trophies.name: First Light
trophies.description: Take your first deliberate step into the story of Leonida.
trophies.hint: Keep moving through the opening sequence; this one is designed to arrive naturally.

trophies.name: A Plan of Your Own
trophies.description: Finish the first job that asks both partners to trust the same plan.
trophies.hint: Listen for the hand-off before leaving the job area.

trophies.name: Salt on the Dashboard
trophies.description: Reach the coast with the people who will shape your next chapter.
trophies.hint: The scene triggers after the waterfront route, not at the first beach access.

trophies.name: A Favor Remembered
trophies.description: Complete a side job whose payoff comes from an earlier conversation.
trophies.hint: Check your messages between major jobs; some invitations are easy to miss.

trophies.name: Paper Trail
trophies.description: Recover the records that connect two otherwise separate crews.
trophies.hint: Search the office itself before following the obvious exit marker.

trophies.name: The Scenic Route
trophies.description: Choose the longer approach and reach the meeting without raising an alarm.
trophies.hint: A quiet vehicle and a little patience make the detour worthwhile.

trophies.name: Bridge Burner
trophies.description: Leave a high-stakes operation with your getaway still intact.
trophies.hint: Keep the car out of the line of fire until the final turn.

trophies.name: Heat Check
trophies.description: Shake a persistent tail before the next story beat begins.
trophies.hint: Break sight lines, then change direction; top speed alone will not lose a follower.

trophies.name: Nothing Left Behind
trophies.description: Complete a story job without leaving a partner or objective exposed.
trophies.hint: Watch the companion indicator during the final stretch.

trophies.name: Second Door
trophies.description: Find an alternate way out during a mission with a locked-down perimeter.
trophies.hint: Look for service corridors and climbable edges before the timer gets tight.

trophies.name: Welcome Back
trophies.description: Return to a familiar neighborhood after the story has moved on.
trophies.hint: Visit the old block in free roam once the next chapter opens.

trophies.name: A Different Tomorrow
trophies.description: See one of the story's closing outcomes through to its final scene.
trophies.hint: Finish the main arc; the choice itself does not lock this concept milestone.

trophies.name: County Lines
trophies.description: Cross the boundary into every broad region represented on the map.
trophies.hint: Drive through the named district rather than fast-travelling past it.

trophies.name: Open Water
trophies.description: Reach the far side of the bay and return to land under your own power.
trophies.hint: A small boat is safer than trying to swim the whole distance.

trophies.name: High Tide
trophies.description: Find a tide-cut path that only becomes usable at the right moment.
trophies.hint: Revisit the inlet at a different time of day and watch the waterline.

trophies.name: Last Light on the Keys
trophies.description: Watch sunset from the southernmost public overlook.
trophies.hint: Arrive before dusk; the overlook is a short walk above the marina.

trophies.name: No More Road
trophies.description: Reach a remote point beyond the paved routes and stay there long enough to take it in.
trophies.hint: Follow the maintenance track past its last road sign.

trophies.name: A Map in Your Head
trophies.description: Discover a landmark in every corner of Leonida.
trophies.hint: Use the skyline, water towers, and radio masts to orient yourself off-road.

trophies.name: Room for the Night
trophies.description: Check into a roadside motel in three different counties.
trophies.hint: Look for vacancy signs on older highways, not only near the city.

trophies.name: After Hours
trophies.description: Visit a downtown landmark after most of the city has gone quiet.
trophies.hint: The plaza is busiest in daylight; come back well after midnight.

trophies.name: The Backwater Route
trophies.description: Navigate a marsh channel without touching dry land.
trophies.hint: Slow down before narrow bends and let the channel markers guide you.

trophies.name: All Four Directions
trophies.description: Stand at the northern, southern, eastern, and western edges of the traversable map.
trophies.hint: A coastline counts as an edge; the farthest point is not always a road.

trophies.name: Steady Hands
trophies.description: Land a clean sequence at the shooting range without missing a target.
trophies.hint: Let the reticle settle and use controlled shots instead of holding the trigger.

trophies.name: Quiet Entry
trophies.description: Reach an objective unseen and leave without triggering a search.
trophies.hint: Crouch before entering lit areas and watch patrol patterns for a full cycle.

trophies.name: Clean Getaway
trophies.description: Escape a pursuit without a collision or a change of vehicle.
trophies.hint: Use alleys and covered parking to break the search cone, then stay patient.

trophies.name: Soft Landing
trophies.description: Complete a rooftop jump and land upright on the intended platform.
trophies.hint: Ease off the accelerator at the lip; a shorter jump is easier to control.

trophies.name: Good Reflexes
trophies.description: Avoid a close-range attack and turn the opening into a clean counter.
trophies.hint: Wait for the swing cue rather than pressing the dodge button early.

trophies.name: Range Day
trophies.description: Try every weapon class available at a public practice range.
trophies.hint: A single shot with each class is enough; check the range menu for the last slot.

trophies.name: Wheel-to-Wheel
trophies.description: Finish a circuit race without leaving the course or hitting a rival.
trophies.hint: Brake before the apex and give the pack room through the first corner.

trophies.name: One Breath
trophies.description: Complete a long swim from shore to a marked buoy without resting.
trophies.hint: Choose a calm stretch of water and set your route before diving in.

trophies.name: No Hands, No Problem
trophies.description: Finish a short ride using a bicycle's coasting balance instead of pedalling.
trophies.hint: Build speed on the first slope, then keep your steering inputs light.

trophies.name: A Little Practice
trophies.description: Improve a personal best in any repeatable time trial.
trophies.hint: Choose a route you know well; a tiny improvement still counts.

trophies.name: First Car, Best Car
trophies.description: Keep one vehicle you found and make it your personal ride.
trophies.hint: Store it at a safehouse garage and customize one part to make it yours.

trophies.name: Paint by Numbers
trophies.description: Build a two-tone custom paint job at a neighborhood workshop.
trophies.hint: Apply a primary color and a contrasting secondary finish in one visit.

trophies.name: The Long Haul
trophies.description: Drive from the city center to the northern county without changing vehicles.
trophies.hint: Refuel before leaving town and avoid shortcuts that put the car in water.

trophies.name: Wings Over Water
trophies.description: Land a light aircraft at a small airstrip on the first approach.
trophies.hint: Line up early and let the runway come to you instead of forcing the descent.

trophies.name: Dockside Delivery
trophies.description: Bring a boat to a marked pier without scraping either side.
trophies.hint: Approach slowly and use short throttle taps for the final few meters.

trophies.name: Two Wheels, One Line
trophies.description: Hold a motorcycle wheelie through a full city block.
trophies.hint: Use a straight, quiet street and ease the throttle as the front wheel rises.

trophies.name: Park It Like You Mean It
trophies.description: Park three different vehicle types entirely inside their marked spaces.
trophies.hint: Try a car, a bike, and a boat trailer at the same public lot.

trophies.name: Under the Bridge
trophies.description: Fly beneath five different bridges without clipping the structure.
trophies.hint: Scout the clearance on foot first; the broad river crossings are forgiving.

trophies.name: A Better Engine
trophies.description: Install a performance upgrade, then win a race in that vehicle.
trophies.hint: Tune before entering the event so the upgrade is registered for the finish.

trophies.name: No Claim Bonus
trophies.description: Complete a delivery route with the vehicle returned in working order.
trophies.hint: The timer allows a cautious pace; take the wide streets.

trophies.name: Small-Town Welcome
trophies.description: Finish a local favor for someone outside the city limits.
trophies.hint: Look for a request marker near a shop, gas station, or boat ramp.

trophies.name: Night Shift
trophies.description: Complete an optional job that only appears after dark.
trophies.hint: Wait until the street lights come on, then revisit the contact's block.

trophies.name: Cash on the Counter
trophies.description: Earn a payout from three different side activities.
trophies.hint: A race, a delivery, and a small service job make a quick varied route.

trophies.name: Fish Story
trophies.description: Bring home a catch from both fresh water and salt water.
trophies.hint: The bait shop stocks different gear for inland ponds and coastal piers.

trophies.name: A Favor for the Neighborhood
trophies.description: Help a local business recover an item without damaging its storefront.
trophies.hint: Ask nearby witnesses before searching the alley behind the shop.

trophies.name: Runner's High
trophies.description: Complete a footrace event without using a vehicle between checkpoints.
trophies.hint: Study the route markers first and cut through public paths, not private yards.

trophies.name: The Spare Key
trophies.description: Find the optional cache that turns a routine errand into a bigger payout.
trophies.hint: Listen for a clue in the contact's final line before the job begins.

trophies.name: Rain Check
trophies.description: Finish an outdoor activity while a storm is passing through.
trophies.hint: Check the sky before starting; the weather window is brief but forgiving.

trophies.name: Quiet Reputation
trophies.description: Complete three paid jobs for the same contact without a failed attempt.
trophies.hint: Return to the contact after each payout instead of chasing a new marker.

trophies.name: Leave It Better
trophies.description: Finish a community task and return the borrowed equipment.
trophies.hint: The hand-back point is separate from the task marker, usually nearby.

trophies.name: Two Names on the Guest List
trophies.description: Bring your partner to a public event and stay until the closing moment.
trophies.hint: Invite them before entering the venue; leaving early cancels the scene.

trophies.name: Good Company
trophies.description: Spend an evening with three different acquaintances across the map.
trophies.hint: Accept the small invitations that arrive between larger story jobs.

trophies.name: The Honest Answer
trophies.description: Choose a candid response in a conversation that offers an easy lie.
trophies.hint: The option is a dialogue choice, not a timed action.

trophies.name: Old Friends, New City
trophies.description: Reconnect with a familiar face in a place neither of you expected.
trophies.hint: Revisit the diner after the second major story milestone.

trophies.name: Make It Right
trophies.description: Resolve a disagreement by returning something that was never yours.
trophies.hint: Search the apartment before calling the other person back.

trophies.name: A Seat at the Table
trophies.description: Attend a gathering after completing favors for two people in the group.
trophies.hint: The invitation appears only after both side-story threads are active.

trophies.name: Say It with Flowers
trophies.description: Leave a small gift at a friend's doorstep when they are away.
trophies.hint: A market stall near the canal sells the item; visit in daytime.

trophies.name: Room to Forgive
trophies.description: Rebuild trust with a contact after a choice has strained the relationship.
trophies.hint: Complete a favor without demanding an extra cut, then check in again.

trophies.name: One More Song
trophies.description: Stay for a full set at a small live-music venue.
trophies.hint: Find a seat near the back and let the performance finish.

trophies.name: Spare Change
trophies.description: Win a round of an arcade game using only the starting credits.
trophies.hint: Choose the cabinet with the shortest rules card and learn its timing.

trophies.name: Local Knowledge
trophies.description: Read five public notices that reveal something about their neighborhood.
trophies.hint: Community boards often sit outside libraries, laundromats, and corner stores.

trophies.name: A Picture of the Place
trophies.description: Take a photo at sunrise, in the rain, and after dark.
trophies.hint: Use the in-game camera and wait for each condition to be visible in the frame.

trophies.name: Three Strikes
trophies.description: Roll a clean game at the neighborhood bowling alley.
trophies.hint: Aim just off center and keep the release smooth.

trophies.name: Sunday Best
trophies.description: Show up to a public gathering wearing a complete outfit from local shops.
trophies.hint: Match a top, bottoms, and shoes before entering the event space.

trophies.name: Channel Surfer
trophies.description: Listen to five radio stations for long enough to identify their sound.
trophies.hint: Give each station a little airtime while driving between other activities.

trophies.name: Leonida, Unhurried
trophies.description: Complete one story beat, one side favor, and one quiet evening in a single session.
trophies.hint: There is no timer: let the day unfold at its own pace.
